newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Salins du Midi bids for Austria's Salinen.
newsitem.headline: Salins du Midi bids for Austria's Salinen.

text.p: France's Compagnie des Salins du Midi, a unit of salt and chemicals group Morton International Inc, said on Thursday it was bidding to buy Austrian salt monopoly Salinen AG from the Austrian state.

The move represented Salins' core element in its planned expansion into central and eastern Europe, the French firm said in a statement. No details concerning the value of the offer were made available.
Morton of the U.S. and Salins are together the biggest producer of salt in the world, the statement said, and the acquisition of Salinen would make Salins the second-largest salt producer in Europe.

Other parties who have reported an interest in buying Salinen are a group around Raiffeisenlandesbank Oberoesterreich reg.GenmbH, former Austrian finance minister Hannes Androsch and sugar producer Agrana Beteiligungs-AG.
The state put Salinen into the hands of state holding company OeIAG in August 1996 so that OeIAG could privatise the salt producer. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 256
